p, k = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def find_parent(x, parent):
    if parent[x] == x:
        return x
    parent[x] = find_parent(parent[x], parent)
    return parent[x]

def unite(a, b, parent, component_count):
    a = find_parent(a, parent)
    b = find_parent(b, parent)
    if a == b:
        return component_count
    component_count -= 1
    parent[b] = a
    return component_count

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    result = 1
    base %= MOD
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return result

if k == 0:
    print(mod_pow(p, p - 1))
else:
    parent = [i for i in range(p)]
    component_count = p - (1 if k > 1 else 0)
    for i in range(1, p):
        component_count = unite(i, (i * k) % p, parent, component_count)
    print(mod_pow(p, component_count))
